sections.title: Article 1: General Provisions
items: These Terms of Use (hereinafter, the “Terms”) apply to all actions taken by users when using “AiKano,” an AI character chat service provided by the operator (hereinafter, the “Service”).
These Terms set forth the conditions for using the Service. Users shall use the Service in accordance with these Terms.
By using the Service, users are deemed to have agreed to all provisions set forth in these Terms.

sections.title: Article 2: Amendments to These Terms of Use
items: We may amend these Terms of Use at any time without obtaining the user's consent.
If these Terms of Use are amended, we will promptly post the amended Terms of Use on the Service.
The amended Terms of Use will take effect when they are posted on the Service.

sections.title: Article 3: Purpose of the Service
items: The Service is an interactive entertainment service provided by us to users that uses artificial intelligence (AI) technology to enable conversations with virtual characters.

All characters appearing in the Service (hereinafter referred to as “AI Characters”) are fictional and are not real people. Responses in the Service are generated by AI and our response system. Our staff may be involved in some interactions to improve the quality of responses.

The Service is not intended to facilitate interactions between users and does not constitute an “Internet Dating Service” as defined under the Act on Regulation of Businesses Involving Dating Services.

sections.title: Article 4: Eligibility
items: Only individuals aged 18 or older may use this Service.
High school students may not use this Service, even if they are 18 or older.
By starting to use this Service, the user represents and warrants to us that they are at least 18 years old and are not a high school student.
If we determine that a user is under 18, we will immediately suspend their use of this Service.

sections.title: Article 5: Notices from Us
items: We will notify users of necessary matters from time to time by posting them on the Service, sending emails, or by any other method we deem appropriate.
Notices under the preceding paragraph will take effect when we post them on the Service or send them by email or other means.

sections.title: Article 6: Account Management
items: Users are responsible for managing their account information.
We accept no responsibility for any damages resulting from unauthorized use of an account.
Users may not hold multiple accounts or transfer or lend their account to another person.

sections.title: Article 7: Usage Fees
items: Text chat uses 5 points per message (equivalent to ¥50).
Each point costs ¥10 (tax included). Bonus points are awarded when you buy points in bulk. For details on purchase plans, see the points purchase page in the Service.
We award 25 free points when you sign up (enough for your first 5 messages). You can also earn a 10-point daily login bonus, valid for 30 days.
Typical point costs: text chat, 5 points; premium content (such as videos), at the price shown for each item. Point costs are subject to change without notice.

We offer the following monthly subscriptions: Standard Plan (¥2,980/month, 300 messages) and Premium Plan (¥4,980/month, 500 messages). If you exceed your monthly message allowance, you can continue using either plan for 3 points per message.

Monthly subscriptions renew automatically on the same date each month. You can cancel at any time from My Page. After cancellation, you can continue using the Service until the end of the current billing period.
We also offer 30-day passes payable at convenience stores or via PayPay (Standard: ¥2,980; Premium: ¥4,980). 30-day passes do not renew automatically.
Due to the nature of digital content, purchases of points and 30-day passes are non-refundable.
Purchased points do not expire. However, points awarded as bonuses, such as daily login bonuses, expire 30 days after they are awarded.
When you close your account, all points you own will be deleted.
You are responsible for communication charges and other costs required to use the Service.
When you use paid services, we will not charge any additional fees, including interest, administrative fees, or late fees.

The Service is for entertainment purposes. Purchasing points gives you the right to use digital content in exchange for payment. Points are not intended for investment or profit, and cannot be exchanged for cash.

sections.title: Article 8: AI Characters (Important)
items: All AI characters appearing in this Service are fictional and have no connection whatsoever to any real people, organizations, characters, or other entities.

Responses in this Service are generated by AI and our response system. To improve response quality, staff may be involved in some interactions. We do not guarantee the accuracy, appropriateness, or truthfulness of any responses.
Because AI character responses are probabilistically generated based on training data, they may differ from users’ expectations or contain contradictory or inaccurate information.
Users must not rely on AI character responses as real-world advice or as professional medical, legal, financial, or other advice.

Conversations with AI characters are for entertainment purposes. We accept no responsibility if a user develops emotional dependence or experiences adverse effects on their real life as a result of using this Service.
AI characters are portrayed as fictional people aged 18 or older. Characters whose ages are not explicitly stated are also portrayed as adults aged 18 or older.

sections.title: Article 9: Prohibited Conduct
sections.preamble: Users must not engage in any of the following activities when using the Service:
items: Violating these Terms of Use
Violating any laws or regulations, or public order and morals
Engaging in activities for commercial or affiliate purposes, or for advertising or solicitation
Requesting AI characters to adopt settings or portrayals that suggest a person under the age of 18

Creating or requesting content involving child pornography, child abuse, incest (portrayed in a way that suggests an actual family relationship), or impersonation of real people (such as entertainers or public figures)
Generating or eliciting, through AI characters, content that promotes crime, suicide, self-harm, drug use, or other illegal or harmful activities
Redistributing, reselling, or publishing AI-generated content obtained through the Service to third parties
Misrepresenting an AI character’s response as something said by a real person
Infringing, or potentially infringing, the intellectual property rights of other users, third parties, or the Company, including copyrights and trademarks
Infringing the property, privacy, portrait, or publicity rights of other users, third parties, or the Company
Discriminating against, defaming, or slandering other users, third parties, or the Company, or damaging their reputation or credibility
Interfering with the Company’s operation of the Service
Using the Service while impersonating a third party
Attempting to gain unauthorized access to the Service, reverse engineer it, or extract its AI models
Using responses from the Service as training data for other AI models
A single user holding multiple accounts
Multiple users sharing the same account
Transferring or lending an account for the Service
Encouraging any of the activities listed above
Any other activity that the Company deems inappropriate
sections.suffix: If the Company confirms that a user has engaged in any prohibited activity listed above, it may suspend the user’s access to the Service or terminate their membership without prior notice.

sections.title: Article 10: Account Termination
items: Users may stop using the Service and terminate their membership at any time in accordance with these Terms and the procedures established by us.
You can terminate your membership through Settings on your My Page.
If there are no issues with the user's use of the Service, termination will be processed immediately after the request is submitted.
If a user has not logged in for a certain period of time (180 days or more), their membership will be treated as terminated.
When a user terminates their membership, they will lose all rights as a member, including the right to use the Service and the right to receive information through the Service's notification feature.
Upon termination of membership, all points held by the user will be deleted. Purchased points are non-refundable.
No fees or other charges apply to membership termination.
If a user engages in any prohibited conduct set forth in Article 9, we may terminate their membership without prior notice.
We shall not be liable for any damages suffered by a user whose membership has been terminated.

sections.title: Article 11: Handling of Chat Data
items: We may store and analyze chats between users and AI characters to improve our services, enhance the quality of AI responses, detect misuse, and comply with applicable laws and regulations.
We may use chat data to improve our services and train AI after processing it so that individuals cannot be identified.

If illegal activity (such as requests for child pornography or the promotion of criminal acts) is detected, we may preserve the relevant chat logs as evidence and provide them to law enforcement authorities when necessary.
Users enter personal information (such as their real name, address, or phone number) at their own responsibility, and we are not liable for any resulting damages.

sections.title: Article 12: Advertising
items: We may provide users with advertisements from us and our advertisers through the Service.
We do not guarantee the content of services provided to users by advertisers, nor are we responsible for any results arising from those services.
Users agree to hold us harmless from any loss or damage resulting from their use of advertisements or any actions taken in connection with them.

sections.title: Article 13: Deletion of Information
items: If we confirm that a user has engaged in any prohibited conduct set forth in Article 9 of these Terms of Use, we will delete information related to that conduct without prior notice to the user.
If a user contacts us with an inquiry regarding a deletion set forth in the preceding paragraph, we will have no obligation to explain the reason for the deletion.

sections.title: Article 14: Disclaimer
items: We make no warranties whatsoever regarding the accuracy, reliability, usefulness, legality, currency, or any other aspect of information provided to users through the Service, including responses from AI characters.
We shall not be liable for any mental, physical, or financial harm suffered by users as a result of the content of AI characters’ responses.
The Service is intended for entertainment purposes. AI characters are not a substitute for real-life relationships, medical advice, legal advice, financial advice, or other professional advice.
We shall not be liable if a user develops psychological dependence as a result of using the Service. Where appropriate, we recommend consulting a qualified mental health professional.
We shall not be liable for any consequences arising from a user’s use of the Service, or from any malfunction or interruption of the Service.
Users understand and agree that AI technology is still developing and may not always provide the responses they expect.

sections.title: Article 15: Termination of the Service
items: The Company may, at any time and upon notice to users, terminate the provision of the Service to users or any part of the Service.

sections.title: Article 16: Suspension of the Service
sections.preamble: We may temporarily suspend the Service without prior notice to users if any of the following applies:
items: When necessary for the maintenance or construction of equipment used to provide the Service
If a failure occurs in equipment used to provide the Service
If a failure occurs in an AI foundation model or external API service (such as OpenAI or Anthropic)
If we determine that temporarily suspending the Service is necessary due to other operational or technical issues

sections.title: Article 17: Handling of Personal Information
items: We will appropriately protect users’ personal information and comply with the “Privacy Policy” posted separately on this service.

sections.title: Article 18: Intellectual Property Rights
items: The User acknowledges and agrees that the information provided to the User by the Company through the Service (including character settings, illustrations, text, audio, and software) is protected by copyright, trademark rights, patent rights, and other intellectual property rights and laws.

The ownership of copyright in content generated by AI through the Service (including chat content and generated images) shall be determined separately by the Company. Users may not use such content commercially, redistribute it, or distribute derivative works.
All rights to AI character names, settings, visuals, and other elements belong to the Company.

sections.title: Article 19: Claims for Damages
items: If a user violates these Terms of Use or uses the Service unlawfully and causes damage to our company, we will seek appropriate compensation for the damages.

sections.title: Article 20: Governing Law and Jurisdiction
items: These Terms of Use shall be governed by the laws of Japan.

In the event of any dispute arising in connection with the use of the Service, the parties agree that, depending on the amount in controversy, the Osaka District Court or the Osaka Summary Court shall have exclusive jurisdiction by agreement as the court of first instance.

sections.title: Article 21: Age Verification
items: As this service may contain adult content, it may only be used by individuals who are 18 or older, excluding high school students.
When starting to use this service, users must declare that they are 18 or older.

If we determine that a user is under 18 based on information provided by the user, their usage of the service, or other reasonable means, we may suspend the user's use of the service and delete their account.
If we discover that a user is under 18, purchased points will not be refunded, except in cases where a minor's contract is canceled.

sections.title: Article 22: Miscellaneous
items: If any issue arises between the User and the Company, both parties shall discuss it in good faith and endeavor to resolve it.
Any matters concerning the use of this Service that are not addressed in these Terms of Use shall be governed by rules separately established by the Company.
